Import gedroogde biologische mango vanuit Burkina Faso

description.narrative: Symfonio B.V. imports ecological products from Burkina Faso. The company started with the import of fonio, one of the oldest grains in West-Africa. Symfonio focuses not only on the export of this crop, mostly cultivated by women, but also works together closely with the chain partners on training of the farmers and further setting up the production facility. To ensure a more stable income for the farmers and diversifying in its portfolio, Symfonio is now adding dried mango’s. With the pre-financing loan the company can import a container of dried mango, supporting 480 smallholder farmers.

Improving the Access to Healthcare for Mother & Child

description.narrative: The project expects to provide comprehensive emergency obstetric and neonatal care to five districts. These five health districts are the districts of Mangodara in the Cascades Region (southwest Burkina Faso) the districts of Karangasso-vigué and Lena in the Hauts-Bassins Region (also southwest) and the districts of Manni and Gayéri in the Eastern Region.
